title: Observed CN and HCN intensity ratios exhibit subtle variations in extreme galaxy environments
question: How do the integrated line intensity ratios of three energy transitions each of CN and HCN vary across starburst and AGN environments in NGC 3256, NGC 7469, and IRAS 13120-5453?

data.sensitivity: 0.24 to 2.00 mJy beam^-1 across lines and galaxies (determined on dirty cubes)

what.value: Infrared luminosities L_IR for the target galaxies

evidence.quote: ^*b*^$L_{\textsubscript{IR}}$ data from (cite: Sanders2003) and are corrected for luminosity distance.

what.value: AGN contribution to L_IR for NGC 3256 and NGC 7469

evidence.quote: ^*c*^The AGN contribution to $L_\text{IR}$ is estimated from 6 μm and 24 μm emission for NGC 3256 and NGC 7469 (cite: Alonso2012).

what.value: AGN contribution to L_IR for IRAS 13120

evidence.quote: For IRAS 13120, the AGN contribution is estimated from 15 μm and 30 μm (cite: Veilleux2013), 60 μm (cite: Teng2015), and total 8-1000 μm emission (cite: Iwasawa2011).

what.value: SN Type Ia luminosity distance for NGC 7469

evidence.quote: For NGC 7469, the SN Type Ia distance is from (cite: Ganeshalingam2013).

what.value: Inclination angle of 45 +/- 5 degrees for NGC 7469

evidence.quote: For NGC 7469, we corrected the measured intensities in the scatter plots for an inclination angle of $45\pm5$ degrees (cite: Davies2004).

recipe.goal: Calibrate, continuum-subtract, and image uv datasets to matched spatial and spectral resolutions
recipe.method: Calibrate raw uv data, subtract continuum with UVCONTSUB, image in TCLEAN with matched UVRANGE, WIDTH, CELL, and UVTAPER using AUTO-MULTITHRESH down to 2 sigma, and smooth to a common round beam with IMSMOOTH.
key_parameters: Velocity resolution: 26.43 km s^-1 (NGC 3256), 20.68 km s^-1 (NGC 7469), 20.64 km s^-1 (IRAS 13120)

recipe.goal: Create integrated intensity (moment 0) maps, uncertainty maps, and regional line intensity ratios
recipe.method: Extract cleaned smoothed cubes, trim to line emission channels (including all hyperfine components), mask at 3.5 sigma and require emission in all six lines, integrate to moment 0 in K km s^-1, apply primary beam correction, and compute regional and global line ratios.
key_parameters: Nuclear aperture size = FWHM of the beam centered on the 93 GHz continuum peak
assumptions: ALMA calibration uncertainties are 5% (Band 3) and 10% (Band 6 and 7)

recipe.goal: Perform pixel-by-pixel linear regression of line intensities in log-log space
recipe.method: Re-sample imaged cubes to half the beam FWHM (reducing pixel count across beam by factor of 3), recompute masked moment 0 maps, correct NGC 7469 for inclination, and fit log(y) = m log(x) + b using Linmix.
assumptions: Inclination angle of 45 +/- 5 degrees applied to NGC 7469; no inclination correction applied to NGC 3256 or IRAS 13120

recipe.goal: Estimate CN/HCN column density ratios in NGC 3256 using LTE and 1D non-LTE radiative transfer
recipe.method: Estimate column density range via simple LTE calculation, then run online RADEX non-LTE calculations to reproduce observed CN (1-0)/HCN (1-0) intensity ratios in NGC 3256.
key_parameters: Gas temperature = 40 K, H2 number density = 10^7 cm^-3, line width = 10 km s^-1, column density range = 10^13 - 10^17 cm^-2
assumptions: T_gas = 40 K, n(H2) = 10^7 cm^-3, delta V = 10 km s^-1

evidence.quote: The slopes for the CN (2-1)/CN (1-0) ratio are consistent within one standard deviation for all three galaxies in our sample, with an average value of $0.93\pm0.05$ (Figure [\[fig:HCN_and_CN_galax_comps\]](#fig:HCN_and_CN_galax_comps)b).

evidence.loc: The CN/HCN intensity ratio as a probe of radiation field
evidence.quote: Using a gas temperature of $40$ K, an H$_2$ number density of $10^7$ cm$^{-3}$, and a line width of $10$ km s$^{-1}$, we reproduce CN (1-0)/HCN (1-0) $\sim1$ in the non-nuclear pixels of NGC 3256 with a column density ratio of N~CN~/N~HCN~ $\sim10$.

answer_key.quantity: RADEX N_CN/N_HCN column density ratio for NGC 3256 northern nucleus

evidence.loc: The CN/HCN intensity ratio as a probe of radiation field
evidence.quote: The intensity ratio of CN (1-0)/HCN (1-0) $\sim1.7$ in the northern nucleus of NGC 3256 is reproduced with N~CN~/N~HCN~ $\sim24$.
